statement: No source reached has sulforaphane with an acute or conditional NRF2 loss, verified at protein and mRNA at the endpoint time, in a neuron, astrocyte or microglia; every neural loss arm is germline, an unverified knock-down or a line. This is an absence within two independent searches, not exhaustive (one search screened 100 of 199 records; four abstracts and three more candidates have no PMC id).

No source reached pairs a covalent electrophile and a non-covalent KEAP1 binder in one NRF2-loss design in a neural class (Moretti 2021 pairs sulforaphane with a reversible binder in primary neurons and astrocytes without a loss arm in the abstract; its full text is unread; Davies pairs a binder and bardoxolone methyl in epithelium on database labels only).

Zhao 2015: in the Nrf2-null mouse sulforaphane (5 mg/kg at 0.5 and 24 h) did not enhance hematoma clearance (residual haemoglobin at 7 d, a tissue readout); in primary microglia an ARE decoy (an inhibitor, not a loss) attenuated the sulforaphane effect on phagocytosis; tBHQ acted like sulforaphane in wild type; the knock-out check is not printed; the microglial attribution is the authors and global knock-out cannot assign it.
producer_status: supported with the V10 recheck corrections (S26, S27)
